summary: Make the generated graphql command send a valid read-only Woot query by default and reject write-shaped custom queries.
reason: Woot rejects a blank GET /graphql request, and the public command is annotated read-only, so the command must supply a read-only smoke query and reject mutation/subscription documents.
validated_outcome: live dogfood reached Woot and identified only the blank graphql request as failing; the default query uses searchOffers with Limit:1, and unit tests reject mutation/subscription query documents.
